about.zh: 原样：输出就是输入
about.en: unchanged: the output is the input

about.zh: 整张图挪 (dx, dy) 格，图外补 0（或照 border 补）
about.en: the whole picture moved by (dx, dy), padded with 0 (or as border says)

about.zh: 底片：每格变成 1 − 自己
about.en: the negative: every cell becomes 1 − itself

about.zh: 邻居的加权和（互相关）：核按行写出，中心对着这一格
about.en: a weighted sum of the neighbours (cross-correlation): the kernel row by row, its centre on the cell

about.zh: (2r+1)² 个权重，按行写出
about.en: (2r+1)² weights, row by row

about.zh: 用核盖印章（卷积）：每个像素按核的样子盖一个，挪到位、乘上权重再相加
about.en: stamping with a kernel (convolution): every pixel presses the kernel’s shape, moved into place, weighted and added up

about.zh: (2r+1)² 个权重，按行写出
about.en: (2r+1)² weights, row by row

about.zh: size×size 的平均
about.en: the average over size × size

about.zh: 高斯模糊：σ，核的半径
about.en: a Gaussian blur: σ, and the kernel’s radius

about.zh: 锐化：原图 + amount ×（原图 − σ 的高斯模糊）
about.en: sharpening: the picture + amount × (the picture − its Gaussian blur of σ)

about.zh: 横向差分：右边邻居 − 自己
about.en: the difference across: right neighbour − itself

about.zh: 两种边都要：|右边邻居 − 自己|
about.en: both kinds of edge: |right neighbour − itself|

about.zh: 两张图逐格取较大
about.en: the larger of two pictures, cell by cell

about.zh: 步幅 2 的卷积层：按核做互相关，再隔点取样
about.en: a convolution layer of stride 2: cross-correlate with the kernel, then keep every other pixel

about.zh: (2r+1)² 个权重，按行写出
about.en: (2r+1)² weights, row by row

about.zh: 向 3×3 平均靠：a + amount ×（平均 − a）；amount 为负是锐化
about.en: a pull towards the 3×3 mean: a + amount × (mean − a); a negative amount sharpens

about.zh: 图块 a 向 a、b 两块提问：两块按 softmax(4 × 平均(a × 这一块)) 加权平均
about.en: patch a asks patches a and b: the two averaged with the weights softmax(4 × average(a × each))

about.zh: 用共享的标量投影生成 Q、K、V，再计算两个图块的注意力
about.en: produce Q, K and V with shared scalar projections, then compute two-patch attention

about.zh: 3×3 邻域内两个方向的梯度平方平均之和
about.en: sum of the mean squared gradients in both directions over a 3×3 neighbourhood

about.zh: Harris 角点响应图
about.en: Harris corner response map

about.zh: 角点：Harris 响应大于 threshold 的地方
about.en: corners: where the Harris response is over threshold

about.zh: 一个角一个点：Harris 响应乘 gain 后的峰（比 3×3 邻居都不小、又大于 above）
about.en: one point a corner: the peaks of the Harris response times gain (no smaller than the 3×3 neighbours, and above `above`)

about.zh: 放大一倍：补零放大，再按核做互相关（转置卷积）
about.en: twice the size: zero-upsampled, then cross-correlated with the kernel (a transposed convolution)

about.zh: (2r+1)² 个权重，按行写出
about.en: (2r+1)² weights, row by row

about.zh: 两个三维向量的叉积 a × b
about.en: the cross product a × b of two 3-vectors

about.zh: 两条线的交点：过 p、q 的线和过 r、s 的线（齐次坐标）
about.en: where two lines meet: the line through p and q and the line through r and s (homogeneous coordinates)

about.zh: 梯度幅值：√(Sobel x² + Sobel y²)
about.en: the gradient magnitude: √(Sobel x² + Sobel y²)

about.zh: 频域低通：半径 R 以内的频率留下（disk 一刀切，gauss 平滑落下）
about.en: a low-pass in frequency: what is within radius R stays (disk cuts sharply, gauss falls smoothly)

about.zh: 清晰度：频谱里离中心超过 beyond 的部分的平均
about.en: sharpness: the mean of the spectrum beyond radius `beyond` from its centre

about.zh: 去网纹：频谱里半径 radius 以外、比 threshold 亮的格子去掉，其余照旧
about.en: descreening: the spectrum’s cells beyond `radius` brighter than `threshold` removed, the rest kept

about.zh: 混合图像：A 的低频 + B 的高频（半径 R 的高斯）
about.en: a hybrid image: the low frequencies of A + the high frequencies of B (a Gaussian of radius R)

about.zh: 缩小：σ 的高斯模糊一次（复制边缘），再隔点取样 halvings 次
about.en: shrinking: one Gaussian blur of σ (the edge replicated), then every other pixel kept, halvings times

about.zh: 图像金字塔：模糊一点（σ = 1，复制边缘）再减半，做 levels 次
about.en: an image pyramid: blur a little (σ = 1, the edge replicated) and halve, levels times
